description: Four eight-step sequencers, A to D, played in the order typed into the row-order box

Each trigger here moves one step to the right, and on to the next row at the end of one

The velocity for the step now playing, 0V to 10V

The gate for that row, whether or not the row is the one playing
The pitch for that row, whether or not the row is the one playing
A trigger each time that row reaches the end of its own length
The pitches of all four rows at once, a channel each

notes: the row order box takes A, B, C and D for those rows, O for any other row, R for any row at all and S to repeat the last one; a lower-case letter plays that row backwards
a digit from 1 to 8 in the row order box jumps to that column of the row being played
the row order is typed into the box on the panel: click the box and type the letters and digits
menu: Gate Mode — sets what the gate outputs do: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Ignore Gate for V/OCT Out — keeps the pitch output following the sequence even on steps whose gate is off
Gate Length — sets how long a Trigger or Retrigger gate lasts, in milliseconds
Possible Characters — lists the letters and digits the row order box accepts
Row Order Text Presets — writes a ready-made row order into the box: AbCd, AAAB, AAABAAACAAAD, AaBbCcDd or OSSS
Copy Row — copies the gates, voltages and velocities of Row A, Row B, Row C or Row D
Paste Row — writes the copied gates, voltages and velocities into Row A, Row B, Row C or Row D
Velocity as Probability — reads each step's velocity knob as the odds of that step's gate firing, a tenth of the knob's voltage being the chance
